**UI Audit Report: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Scanning State)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window:** Maximized, 1024x768 resolution.
*   **Header Bar (0–80px):**
    *   **App Branding (Left):** Icon + Title "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free" at [10, 15].
    *   **Action Bar (Right):** "Buy Now" button [670, 15], Settings icon, Help icon, Hamburger menu, Minimize/Maximize/Close buttons [920–990, 15].
    *   **Navigation Toolbar (Sub-header, 50–110px):** Home icon, Back arrow, Up arrow. Location bar "Windows (C:)" [175, 75]. View toggle (List), Filter button, Search bar [790, 70].
*   **Main Content Area (115–800px):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left, 280px wide):** Tabs ("Path", "Type"). List of root folders (Windows C:, File Path Lost, Reconstructed).
    *   **List Pane (Center, ~540px wide):** Column headers (Checkbox, Name, Date Modified, Type). Scrollable file list.
    *   **Preview Pane (Right, ~200px wide):** File icon, filename, "Open" button, and metadata properties (Size, Date Modified, Path).
*   **Status / Scanning Strip (Bottom, 800–860px):** Full-width blue bar showing current scanning path.
*   **Footer Control Bar (860–950px):**
    *   **Progress Gauge (Left):** Circular percentage indicator.
    *   **Stats & Controls (Center-Right):** Status text, Pause/Stop icons, Elapsed time, History icon.
    *   **Primary Action (Far Right):** "Recover All ..." button.
*   **Taskbar (OS Level, 950–1000px):** Windows Start, Search, Task View, Pinned Apps, System Tray, Clock.

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Header:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Button:** `Buy Now`
*   **Location Bar:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Toolbar:** `Filter` | `Search files or folders`
*   **Tree Headers:** `Path` | `Type`
*   **Tree Items:** `Windows (C:)` | `1.1M` | `File Path Lost` | `4.3K` | `Reconstructed` | `16`
*   **List Headers:** `Name` | `Date Modified` | `Type`
*   **List Items (Sample):** `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder` ... (repeats for actions-runner, azureCli, etc.)
*   **Preview Pane:** `actionarchivecache` | `Open` | `Size` | `4.22 MB` | `Date Modified` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `Path` | `C:\`
*   **Scanning Strip:** `Searching: ...\0040000000AB4F42F3CD0FF\System.Reflection.Emit.ILGeneration.dll`
*   **Footer Stats:** `Advanced Scanning , Files Found: 1139157 (143.74 GB)`
*   **Footer Time:** `Remaining time: 07m43s` | `Reading sector: 134316032/313413598`
*   **Footer Button:** `Recover All ...`
*   **System Clock:** `1:36 PM` | `10/17/2026`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background: `#F5F8FA` (Light Blue-Grey, ESTIMATED)
    *   Header/Footer Background: `#FFFFFF` (White, ESTIMATED)
    *   Scanning Strip Background: `#DCEBFA` (Light Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Selected List Item: `#E1EFFE` (Lighter Blue highlight, ESTIMATED)
*   **Accents & Buttons:**
    *   Primary Action (Recover All): `#2D8CF0` (Bright Blue, ESTIMATED)
    *   Secondary Action (Open): `#AECBF5` (Light Blue button bg, ESTIMATED)
    *   Buy Now Button: `#FFAA00` (Orange/Yellow, ESTIMATED)
    *   Progress Ring: `#2D8CF0` (Blue fill), `#E6E6E6` (Grey track)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#333333` (Dark Grey, ESTIMATED)
    *   Secondary Text/Metadata: `#666666` or `#888888` (Medium Grey, ESTIMATED)
    *   Link/Path Text: `#2D8CF0` (Blue, ESTIMATED)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI / Arial, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Pane Headers (Path, Name, etc.):** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular/Medium.
*   **List Items:** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular.
*   **Stats (Files Found):** Segoe UI, ~13px, Bold (for numbers).
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~12px, Medium.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Icon Sizes:** 16px (Toolbar), 24px (File types), 48px (Preview large icon), 60px (Circular gauge).
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Header: ~50px.
    *   Toolbar: ~45px.
    *   List Rows: ~36px.
    *   Footer Bar: ~90px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Padding: Left 10px, Vertical centering.
    *   Pane Gutter: ~2px (divider width).
    *   Button Padding: Horizontal 20px, Vertical 8px.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px (slight rounding).
    *   Search Bar: ~4px.
    *   Progress Circle: Perfect circle (50%).
*   **Stroke Widths:**
    *   Progress Ring: ~4-5px.
    *   Dividers: 1px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Controls:**
    *   **Buttons:** "Buy Now" (Normal), "Filter" (Normal), "Open" (Normal/Secondary), "Recover All..." (Primary/Enabled).
    *   **Inputs:** Search Box (Empty/Placeholder text).
    *   **Icons:** Home, Nav Arrows, View Switcher, Pause (Two bars), Stop (Square), History (Clock).
    *   **Checkboxes:** Unchecked state visible in list.
*   **States:**
    *   **Selection:** The first item (`actionarchivecache`) is highlighted in the list, triggering content in the Preview pane.
    *   **Process Active:** The scan is running (34%). The "Pause" and "Stop" buttons are available (implied by icons).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Mix of Filled (Folder icons in list/preview) and Outline (Toolbar actions like Filter, Search magnifying glass).
*   **Weights:** Standard line weight (1.5px - 2px) for outlines. Flat vector style for filled icons.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Folder: Standard Windows-style folder, blue tinted.
    *   Progress Gauge: Circular arc with a checkmark or similar indicator inside (partially obscured by % text, looks like a generic 'process' icon inside the ring).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Active Processing (Scanning)**.
*   **Details:**
    *   **Progress:** 34% complete visually indicated by the circular gauge.
    *   **Current Activity:** Deep scanning a specific system DLL (`System.Reflection.Emit.ILGeneration.dll`).
    *   **Performance:** High volume of data found (~1.1M files, 143GB). Estimated remaining time is ~7.5 minutes.
    *   **Motion Cue:** The blue strip at the bottom implies real-time logging of the file currently being read. The progress ring is static in the screenshot but represents an active animation.
